label: Sailboat
description: Wind that pushes us, anchors that hold us back, rocks ahead and the island we're sailing to.

types.label: Wind
types.description: What pushed us forward this period.

types.label: Anchor
types.description: What slowed us down or held us back.

types.label: Rock
types.description: A risk ahead that could sink us if we ignore it.

types.label: Island
types.description: Where we want to get to: a goal, or a change that would get us closer.

questions: Which one anchor could we cut loose this sprint?
Which rock worries us most, and who can help us steer around it?
Is the island still the right destination?
aiGuidance: Wind is what helped; anchors are current drag; rocks are future risks. Rank rocks by likelihood and impact. Suggest at most three action items, each tied to an anchor or a rock, and say which.
